### 2026-10-11 – One could really say It took  *half*  my  *life* away

**15h**

One could really say It took  *half*  my  *life* away

To start of week 1 I wanted to try out something I have dreamed of making  A flight controller for a drone, the only problem being I have never used Any pcb software. The First step was to download which took longer than usual because  I use linux and did not realize that there is a downloadable appimage anyhow this took around an hour
